protocol.name: f-research-v1 P4 C1 correction loop v3 attempt #8

first_hard_gate.name: real_domain_ceiling_and_label_decidability_gate

state_rule.LABEL_NOT_DECODABLE: GT oracle upper 95% CI point estimate < 0.70
state_rule.INPUT_BOTTLENECK: GT oracle point estimate >= 0.70 and input ceiling point estimate < 0.70
state_rule.DOMAIN_USABLE: GT oracle and input ceiling point estimates both >= 0.70

first_hard_gate.claim_rule: Only DOMAIN_USABLE permits a real-domain delta claim
first_hard_gate.nonusable_policy: all real-domain contrasts diagnostic_only; still execute conditions 1-12
first_hard_gate.tie_policy: drop exact zero-direction examples before class matching
first_hard_gate.class_matching: deterministic hash order downsample to minority class within split

flow_coherence.definition: magnitude-weighted resultant length of unit GT-flow directions within frozen Voronoi cells, averaged by cell flow energy
flow_coherence.matched_n_rule: minimum balanced per-class count across three scopes within domain and stratum
flow_coherence.empty_cell_policy: mark unavailable; do not alter thresholds

retinal_drive_transfer.injection_location: before compound-eye sampling and before feature construction
retinal_drive_transfer.injection_dimension: horizontal-direction opponent drive; positive on right-preferring, negative on left-preferring ommatidia
retinal_drive_transfer.slope_fit: OLS through origin across positive SNR levels, per seed
retinal_drive_transfer.no_input_signal_rule: both KC slopes have 95% CI containing zero and absolute point estimate < 0.01
retinal_drive_transfer.decay_localization_rule: earliest adjacent-stage median gain ratio below 0.5; ties choose upstream stage

model.selected_k_rule: largest fallback K with all selected KC reachable and GPU sparse edge representation feasible
model.ridge_selection: train-only 5-fold stratified CV; deterministic tie chooses larger alpha
model.parameter_matching: identical frozen projection/readout dimensions and trainable readout count across condition pairs

condition_matrix.A=0_interpretation: input-information upper bound only; never biological-wiring advantage
condition_matrix.degree_null_invariant: exact in-degree, out-degree, weight multiset, nnz, reciprocal-pair count, and self-loop count equality required

condition_arm_symmetry.rng_streams: numpy SeedSequence spawn using arm-specific child index; require no equal first 4096 uint64 values
condition_arm_symmetry.forbidden: any mutable or label-dependent object identity shared across arms
condition_arm_symmetry.swap_counterfactual: swap condition labels without swapping computations; metric vector must swap exactly within 1e-12
condition_arm_symmetry.confounded_policy: retain numerical values; prohibit scientific claims

branch_localization.hash_algorithm: sha256 over little-endian float32 C-contiguous bytes

stratified_paired_bootstrap.strata: domain x class x coherence stratum

studentized_bootstrap.test_statistic: paired mean divided by paired standard error with +1e-12 guard

redefined_permutation_family.decision: exact sign flip when n<=20, otherwise 65536 deterministic Monte Carlo flips

calibration.null_generator: exchangeable paired Gaussian plus shared stratum random effect; arm-specific independent noise; zero true effect
calibration.global_failure_rule: if any family empirical type-I error exceeds 0.075, label all contrasts uncalibrated

holdout.scene_hash: sha256(UTF-8 scene name) first 8 bytes interpreted big-endian modulo 5
holdout.constructibility: at least one scene and at least two samples per class after label construction in unexposed fold
holdout.matching: within domain and fold, deterministic sha256(sample id) order downsample both classes to minority count

guidance.minimum: real-domain delta >= +0.15 plus transfer adjudication plus localized one-factor ablation
guidance.expected_strong: real-domain delta >= +0.25 plus transfer adjudication plus localized one-factor ablation
